manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Changeling Hero must be exiled by Lagrella, and Wormfang Drake must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Wormfang Drake for its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Lagrella until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
